messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — Northpoint legal wants a quick POC next week. They listed enterprise auth requirements: SAML v2, SCIM for ~180k users, RBAC sync from IdP groups, multi-domain verification, and data residency. Asking whether hosted is acceptable or Dedicated/Private required.

ivan_se: From tech call: they need group->role mapping and delegated tenant admins. Also want audit trails for admin actions (who changed role mappings).

tara_sme: SCIM notes: we can do bulk seed + near-real-time deltas. Default SCIM throttle is 20 rps on Hosted; Dedicated can be raised and we can enable batch endpoints for initial imports. We support externalId, group objects, and custom attrs like 'role_level'.

maria_sec: Security: they require KMS integration (bring your own), encrypted KV for session keys, SOC2 Type II, and 24-month audit log retention. SAML cert rotation policy needs to be documented (recommended 90-day rotation). Also they want proof we don't auto-delete users on transient sync failures.

leo_devops: Dedicated supports customer KMS (AWS/Azure/GCP) and VPC peering. We can forward audit events to their SIEM over HTTPS. For SCIM scale, plan: initial bulk via compressed CSV import then delta sync every 5m.

nina_pricing: Pricing: if they need Dedicated + private control plane + custom KMS, we'll move to enterprise tier. Ballpark: base reserved capacity starts at $30k/mo; exact discount needs QPS/concurrency.

sam_sales: Action items: 1) Tara -> SCIM example payload + Okta mapping snippet, 2) Maria -> SAML cert rotation + security one-pager, 3) Leo -> Dedicated sizing options, 4) Nina -> draft pricing scenarios. Target to send by EOD.

ops_bot: Reminder: attach questionnaire PDF to channel so security can pre-fill.

tara_sme: Example SCIM create (trimmed):
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"a.user@northpoint.com","externalId":"okta-999","name":{"givenName":"A","familyName":"User"},"groups":[{"value":"ops-admins","display":"Ops Admins"}]}
```

tara_sme: Group endpoint returns members as references; include group metadata for role mapping. If they need hierarchical roles, we accept custom attribute x-redwood-role-hierarchy.

maria_sec: Confirmed: we never auto-delete on sync errors. We mark failures, retry with backoff, and require explicit delete via SCIM 'active:false' or admin action.

leo_devops: Domain proofing: we use TXT token per FQDN like `_redwood_verify=NP-xxxxxxxx`. Quarterly rotation supported; verification events are logged.

nina_pricing: I'll produce two quotes: (A) Hosted with contractual addendum for data controls (if legal will allow) and (B) Dedicated + private control plane.

sam_sales: Please upload artifacts to shared folder and ping buyer for IdP creds for dry-run. Target dry-run Thu 11am PT.

ivan_se: SEs can attend dry-run. Also recommend we run an Okta mapping validation beforehand to avoid schema mismatches.

maria_sec: Send their security questionnaire PDF here and I'll annotate standard answers.

sam_sales: Uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/northpoint/sq.pdf (placeholder)

nina_pricing: Will circulate draft SOW by Monday.

sam_sales: Thanks everyone — closing until buyer confirms concurrency numbers.
